name: More Island Events
description: Adds new island events, written by the owner, to the ones the game draws from (more come in later versions). Two here: The Aspiring Adventurer -- a villager who loves to explore sees something glinting off the safe path. "Go investigate!" finds a pile of dirt, a stack of meat (food) or a golden chest of artifacts (tech points); half the time the adventurer gets home (with the find, or with a friend's help), half the time a trap leads to death (a grave) or a disappearance (no grave). "Stay on the safe path" brings them home 9 times in 10; otherwise they are lost: hurt, healed or disabled, a skilled survivalist, killed, gone, or they join another tribe. The event is one more of the game's villager encounters (its two-choice island events), drawn 1 in m + 1 when the encounters are drawn (m the encounters possible then; 1 in m + 2 while The Cave Explorers can happen too), never the village's first island event; it needs two villagers of 14 or more who are not nursing a baby and not the Golden Child, and the adventurer and the friend who may come to help are drawn from them. The reward is a random amount from the smallest to the largest food or tech-point gain of the game's own island events (200 to 1,500 food for the meat, 500 to 4,999 tech points for the chest); with Island Events Scale With Population or With Stored Food and Tech Points ticked, the amount scales as that patch scales the game's own events. Deaths are the game's own ("Unknown causes", with a grave); a disappearance is logged as one in the Deaths log. The popups show the owner's text in pages that fit the screen (OK shows the next). And The Cave Explorers (A New Home only): once The Cave puzzle is done, two friends of 18 or more, at most 5 years apart, wonder what the cave hides. "Don't explore" changes nothing; "Explore the Cave" leads on: "Proceed Further" brings a scream in the dark (they run, then argue, make up, or both fall down a chasm and are gone for good, 1 in 10) or a find (a map that takes both away for good, 1 in 10; gold coins: tech points; a treasure map: three times as many; preserved food: twice the food); "Stay Here" lets them return what they found (food or tech points) or keep it (the researchers' tech points 8 times in 10; otherwise one or both die, with graves). Each award is a random amount from the smallest to the largest food or tech-point gain of the game's own island events (A New Home: 200 to 1,500 food, 500 to 4,999 tech points), scaled as the Aspiring Adventurer's is. Off by default; Owner's Defaults ticks it. **Needs no other patch.** **Unverified in play: the event has not been seen in a running game** (emulated on the stock executable). The companion is "VVFP More Island Events.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; nothing is saved by it.
behavior_changes: The event is one more of the game's villager encounters (its two-choice island events), drawn 1 in m + 1 when the encounters are drawn (m the encounters possible then; 1 in m + 2 while The Cave Explorers can happen too), never the village's first island event. It can happen only while at least two villagers may go: 14 or more (280 age units), alive and present, not carrying a baby, and not the Golden Child; the adventurer and the friend of ending A8 are drawn from them, the friend never the adventurer.

Choice A, "Go investigate!": the find 50% a pile of dirt, 25% meat (a food award: 200 to 1,500 food), 25% a golden chest (a tech award: 500 to 4,999 tech points); then 50% a surviving ending (after the dirt A7 or A9; after a find A1, A5 or A8, which give the reward) and 50% a deadly one (A2 and A4 die, the game's own death with cause -1 and a grave; A3 and A6 disappear, no body), each equally likely within its half.

Choice B, "Stay on the safe path": 90% home safe; 10% lost, then 1 in 6 each: the healers (1 in 3 each: dies; a full recovery; health set to 10-50 and running disliked), joins another tribe (gone for good, no grave), a survivalist (+20 to 30 in Farming, Building, Research or Healing, at most 100), dies under a fallen tree, dies at the bottom of a cliff, disappears.

The reward is drawn, each amount equally likely, from the game's smallest to its largest stock island-event gain of that kind (src/vv_aspiring_adventurer.py AWARD_RANGES), and goes through the game's own food or tech writer; with Island Events Scale With Population or With Stored Food and Tech Points ticked, the amount scales as that patch scales the game's own events. The effects are made when the answer is clicked, as the game's own two-choice events make theirs; a disappearance is told to the Cause of Death companion (VvfpCauseVanishedBy), so its Deaths log records it as one.

The owner's words, by translation key (the event's popup shows the player's language when a translation has them), are laid out in pages that fit the game's popup -- whole paragraphs, else whole sentences -- each shown in turn with OK.

The Cave Explorers (A New Home): one more encounter like The Aspiring Adventurer (with both possible, each is 1 in m + 2), only while The Cave puzzle is done (world byte +0x9FA8) and two villagers who may go on The Aspiring Adventurer are 18 or more (360 age units) and at most 5 years (100 age units) apart; the pair is drawn among those ordered pairs. Three questions in the encounter dialog: the answers are given new words (the constructor's own text setter 0x4015A0) and centred again (the buttons' own size and move). Explore -> Proceed Further: 50% A (10% argue, 80% make up, 10% the chasm: both removed with no body), 50% B (10% a map: both removed with no body; 30% gold coins a normal tech award, 30% a treasure map 3x, 30% preserved food 2x food); Stay Here -> return (food or tech, 50/50, a normal award) or keep (50% the researchers' normal tech award, 25% name2 and name1 die, 25% name2 dies: health 0, a body and a grave). The effects are made when the answer leading to them is clicked; each removal is told to the Cause of Death companion (VvfpCauseVanishedBy).
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion writes each site at run time, only after verifying every site's stock bytes (all of them, or none); without it the event does not exist.
Every stock event, its odds, the island-event timer and counting, the rescue rules and Custom Island Events are unchanged; nothing is saved by the companion.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the draw, the popup pages, both choices' effects and the install with every other patch emulated on the stock executable in tests/test_aspiring_adventurer.py (The Cave Explorers: every path, its effects and its pages, in tests/test_cave_explorers.py); runtime/player confirmation pending
